rationale: Quinbrook's hierarchy defines PurposeEnergy as the acquired portfolio company and Middlebury as a PurposeEnergy project. Government evidence identifies MRRC LLC as the facility owner and PurposeEnergy as its sole member or operator. No separate Middlebury sponsor mandate, co-owner, later equity transfer or pending sale was found.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Middlebury Resource Recovery Center PortCo record into PurposeEnergy.
Preserve Middlebury Resource Recovery Center, LLC and PurposeEnergy-Middlebury as project/SPV aliases beneath PurposeEnergy.
Preserve the facility's development, October 21, 2024 commercial-operation date, 1.014 MW capacity, location, throughput and customer facts.
Attribute Quinbrook and the Net Zero Power Fund only at the PurposeEnergy platform level.
Exclude VEDA, Bank of New England, tax-equity references, feedstock customers, municipal parties and grid counterparties from ownership without direct equity evidence.
Treat July 18, 2018 only as the date of evidence showing Purpose Energy was MRRC LLC's sole member, not as an acquisition closing.
unresolvedQuestions: Quinbrook's exact stake, legal close, sellers, rollover and acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed.
The current MRRC member register and Purpose Energy, Inc.-to-PurposeEnergy LLC succession date are not public.
The tax-equity investor, closing and rights remain unresolved and cannot support co-ownership.
fieldCorrections: Do not store 2018-07-18 as an acquisition or investment entry date; it is the date of the municipal evidence showing existing sole membership.
